scaleBeatText: With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

⛓️ The Bloodied doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 32 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 92) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 34, fan favor 41 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 92) ◈ the Witness — 7 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 73) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 37) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 7 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 40) ◈ the Relay — S
